tasks.subject: Task 1: Uniform borrow-on-call (existing representation)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Applying any function value borrows it (no consume); Perceus drops function values at last use. Keep existing representation. Full corpus stays green.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs", "src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "RUNNER -p \"/borrow-on-call/\" && full suite", "acceptanceCriteria": ["enterRC does not consume closure on call", "closure called N times = 0 dups + 1 drop, balanced", "full corpus green, Suite B regenerated", "balanceLint clean"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add shared-env representation to RC store
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add RVRecMember value, NGroupCode/NEnv nodes, valueChildren, route incref/dropAddr/boxedChildren/rendering, static empty-env sentinel. Additive; corpus stays green.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Value.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "RUNNER -p \"/rvrecmember-rep/\" && full suite", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RVRecMember/NGroupCode/NEnv compile + exported", "valueChildren correct for all 3 variants", "incref/dropAddr on RVRecMember act on env addr; no-op on sentinel", "RVRecMember renders <closure>", "corpus green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Evaluate letrec via shared env + code pointer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** evalExprRC LetRec installs group code static + shared env E (or sentinel) + members as inline RVRecMember; enterRC handles RVRecMember (reconstruct sibling scope inline, borrow, enter). Boundary still rejects escaping shapes.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/Interp/RC/Machine.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "RUNNER -p \"/sharedenv-eval/\" && letrec corpus", "acceptanceCriteria": ["non-escaping mutual group value-matches + heap-balanced", "capture-free group allocs zero group cells", "capturing group allocs one E, freed once", "sibling calls allocate nothing"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Simplify Perceus letrec instrumentation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Perceus treats a group as one synthetic owned E (born rc=1, dropped at body last use); captures borrowed into bodies with dup-on-consume; members ordinary. Remove region/multiset/ctxExempt for the new path. Introduce ctxBorrow.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/Wok/IR/Perceus.hs", "test/Spec.hs"], "verifyCommand": "RUNNER -p \"/sharedenv-pass/\" && Suite G non-escaping", "acceptanceCriteria": ["non-escaping borrow-capture group balanceLint-clean + heap-balanced", "no per-member multiset dups (capture held once in E)", "prop_m2a1LintClean green"]}
```

tasks.description:
